parsed.rationale: Customer requests the ability to schedule weekly exports directly to their S3 bucket instead of manually downloading CSVs; they note it is not blocking and would save time weekly.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi there—thanks for the feature request. Scheduling recurring exports directly to your S3 bucket (so you can avoid manual CSV downloads) makes sense and would likely save time for your team.

To help us route this correctly, could you share two quick details:
1) Which exports are you looking to schedule (e.g., specific report(s)/data type(s) or all available exports)?
2) Do you need the output format to remain CSV, or are other formats acceptable?

Once we have that, we can log the requirements for product review. In the meantime, if you’d like, we can also share any existing export automation/workarounds that may already be available for your current setup.
promised_actions: Log the request for product review after receiving the requested details
Share any existing export automation/workarounds if the customer wants them
safety_notes: Did not promise delivery timeline, SLA, or completion of the feature.
Did not claim root cause or security/compliance conclusions.
Asked for minimal clarification to define scope and format requirements for the feature request.

parsed.customer_impact: Would save the customer’s data team a couple of hours per week by eliminating manual CSV downloads and enabling scheduled exports to S3.

The current workflow involves manually downloading CSVs.
